tajima-appetizer-karaage-02.webp.alt: A plate of karaage, seasoned deep-fried chicken, on lettuce with a lemon wedge and a spoonful of mayonnaise dusted with chili, on a wooden table.

tajima-college-heights-exterior-night-si.alt: The lit Tajima storefront on El Cajon Boulevard at night. The flame-and-kanji mark sits beside white block letters on a black sign, and the maple-lined dining room is visible through the windows.

tajima-college-heights-interior-dining-r.alt: The College Heights dining room before service. Long maple communal tables and box stools run down the room under an exposed black ceiling, with the open kitchen visible past the counter at the far end.

tajima-college-heights-interior-manga-wa.alt: A corridor at College Heights papered floor to ceiling with black and white manga pages, broken up by panels of maple slats.

tajima-college-heights-ramen-bar-counter.alt: The ramen bar at College Heights. A row of maple stools runs along a maple counter, with the craft beer tap wall and its row of tap handles behind it.

tajima-crown-point-bar-seating-surfboard.alt: The counter at Crown Point. Wooden stools run along a white counter, with a red surfboard mounted on the cedar wall above and the dining room visible through a cut-out window.

tajima-crown-point-dining-room-arched-wo.alt: The Crown Point dining room before service. Tables and wooden chairs sit under a barrel-vaulted ceiling of curved wood slats lit from behind, with the service counter running along the left wall.

tajima-crown-point-exterior-night-neon-r.alt: The red neon RAMEN arrow mounted on the corner of the Tajima Crown Point building at night, with the lit Tajima Ramen sign running along the storefront behind it.

_altStatus: Alt text is hand-written per photo and is the one field the generator cannot produce, so a regenerate must not clobber it. Reviewed alt exists ONLY for photos actually placed on a page; everything else still reads [DRAFT, NEEDS REVIEW] and is not placed. src/_data/roomPhotos.js throws at build time if it is asked for a photo whose alt is still draft, so a photo cannot reach a page without one.
